        f"{bool(e.n > 1 or e.temperature > 0)}",
        f"actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.agent_loop_config_path={agent_cfg}",
        f"actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers={t.agent_num_workers}",
        f"trainer.n_gpus_per_node={t.n_gpus}",
        "trainer.nnodes=1",
        f"trainer.logger={loggers}",
        f"trainer.project_name={t.project_name}",
        f"trainer.experiment_name={t.experiment_name}",
        f"trainer.default_local_dir={run_dir / 'checkpoints'}",
        f"trainer.val_before_train={t.val_before_train}",
        f"trainer.test_freq={t.test_freq}",
        f"trainer.save_freq={t.save_freq}",
        f"trainer.total_epochs={t.total_epochs}",
        *([f"trainer.total_training_steps={t.total_training_steps}"] if t.total_training_steps is not None else []),
        f"trainer.resume_mode={t.resume_mode}",
    ]


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", default=os.environ.get("TRACE_CONFIG", ""))
    parser.add_argument("--run-name", default="",
                        help="override run.name (e.g. smoke runs get their own dir)")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--set", dest="overrides", action="append", default=[], metavar="section.key=value",
        help="override a config setting for this run, e.g. "
             "--set steering.eta_max=0.3 (repeatable). Goes through the same "
             "validation as the file and is recorded in the launch manifest.",
    )
    args, passthrough = parser.parse_known_args()
    if not args.config:
        raise SystemExit("--config (or TRACE_CONFIG) is required")
    config_path = Path(args.config).resolve()
    cfg = load_config(config_path, overrides=args.overrides)
    # Each experiment owns a complete copy of the template, so a copy can fall
    # behind a mechanism change. Say so at launch.
    template_path = ROOT / "configs" / "pgs.yaml"
    if config_path != template_path and template_path.exists():
        drift = template_drift(config_path, template_path)
        for key in drift["missing"]:
            print(f"[launch] NOTE config is behind the template: {key} is missing "
                  "(falling back to the code default)")
        for key in drift["extra"]:
            print(f"[launch] NOTE config has {key}, which the template does not")
    if args.overrides:
        print(f"[launch] config overrides: {' '.join(args.overrides)}")
    if args.run_name:
        cfg.run.name = args.run_name
        cfg.train.experiment_name = args.run_name  # tracking name follows the run
        # Keep the raw snapshot in step with the dataclass — it is what gets
        # written out below and read back by every worker.
        cfg.raw.setdefault("run", {})["name"] = args.run_name
        cfg.raw.setdefault("train", {})["experiment_name"] = args.run_name

    runs_root = Path(cfg.run.runs_root)
    if not runs_root.is_absolute():
        runs_root = ROOT / runs_root
    run_dir = runs_root / cfg.run.name
    fingerprint = objective_fingerprint(cfg)

    # 改 objective 的 Hydra passthrough 无论 dry-run/正式都必须拒绝；科学键只走 --set。
    objective_prefixes = ("algorithm.",)
    objective_substrings = (
        "loss_agg_mode", "adv_estimator", "optim.lr", "ppo_epochs",
        "ppo_mini_batch_size", "train_files", "val_files", "seed", "total_training_steps",
    )
    for item in passthrough:
        key = item.split("=", 1)[0].lstrip("+")
        if key.startswith(objective_prefixes) or any(sub in key for sub in objective_substrings):
            raise SystemExit(
                f"FATAL: passthrough override {item!r} changes the optimisation "
                "objective but bypasses the fingerprint — use --set (config-level) instead"
            )

    # dry-run 是真正无副作用模式：严验配置、算指纹/命令并打印；不网络、不写盘。
    if args.dry_run:
        cmd = build_command(cfg, run_dir) + list(passthrough)
        print(f"[launch] objective fingerprint: {fingerprint}")
        print(f"[launch] dry-run run_dir={run_dir}")
        print("[launch] " + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
        return 0

    # 正式依赖门必须先于 mkdir/effective/fingerprint，失败不污染 run_dir。
    preflight_researcher(cfg)
    if cfg.steering.enabled and cfg.steering.doc_source == "static":
        preflight_static_doc_table(cfg.steering.doc_table)

    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Resolve template + profiles + overrides ONCE, write the result, and point
    # every consumer at that file (two readers resolving "the config"
    # differently is the same class of failure as an env var shadowing a file).
    effective_path = run_dir / "effective_config.yaml"
    header = (
        "# RESOLVED CONFIG — written by launch_train.py, read by every worker.\n"
        "# Do not edit: it is regenerated at each launch from\n"
        f"#   config   : {config_path}\n"
        + "".join(f"#   --set    : {o}\n" for o in args.overrides)
        + f"# objective fingerprint: {fingerprint}\n"
    )
    effective_path.write_text(
        header + yaml.safe_dump(cfg.raw, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # Resuming into a run directory whose objective differs means continuing one
    # experiment's checkpoint under another's objective.
    stamp_path = run_dir / "objective_fingerprint.txt"
    if stamp_path.exists():
        previous = stamp_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if previous != fingerprint and cfg.train.resume_mode != "disable":
            raise SystemExit(
                f"[launch] FATAL: {run_dir} was created with objective fingerprint "
                f"{previous}, this launch resolves to {fingerprint}. Resuming would "
                "continue one experiment's checkpoints under another's objective.\n"
                "         Use a different --run-name for this arm, or set "
                "train.resume_mode=disable if you really mean to restart here."
            )
    else:
        stamp_path.write_text(fingerprint + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[launch] objective fingerprint: {fingerprint}")

    # The vendored verl is prepended to PYTHONPATH so the run imports EXACTLY
    # the patched code shipped with this repo.
    vendored_verl = ROOT / "verl"
    verl_path = ""
    if (vendored_verl / "verl" / "__init__.py").exists():
        verl_path = str(vendored_verl)
        print(f"[launch] verl from: {verl_path} (vendored)")
    else:
        print("[launch] WARNING: vendored verl missing — falling back to the venv's verl")

    env = dict(os.environ)
    pythonpath = ":".join(
        p for p in (verl_path, str(ROOT / "src"), env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")) if p
    )
    env.update(
        {
            # The RESOLVED config, not the template: workers must see the same
            # profiles and --set overrides the trainer was launched with.
            "TRACE_CONFIG": str(effective_path),
            "TRACE_RUN_DIR": str(run_dir),
            "TRACE_LAUNCH_ID": uuid4().hex,
            "TRACE_AGENT_WORKERS": str(cfg.train.agent_num_workers),
            "PYTHONPATH": pythonpath,
            "CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER": "PCI_BUS_ID",   # mixed-GPU host discipline
            "HYDRA_FULL_ERROR": "1",
        }
    )
    # Settings that reach verl through the environment because verl reads them
    # there. The CONFIG is the source of truth; these are transport.
    env["TRACE_AGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_S"] = str(cfg.train.agent_task_timeout_s)
    # 勿设 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True:与 vLLM
    # CuMemAllocator(sleep/wake 内存池)不兼容,worker 启动即 assert 拒绝
    # (pytorch#147851;pgs_base 首启实测)。显存防御仅靠 rollout_gpu_mem。
    env["VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT"] = str(cfg.train.vllm_rpc_timeout_ms)
    if cfg.train.dist_backend:
        env["VERL_DIST_BACKEND"] = cfg.train.dist_backend
    else:
        env.pop("VERL_DIST_BACKEND", None)
    if cfg.train.fsdp_mode == "noshard":
        env["VERL_FSDP_NO_SHARD"] = "1"
    else:
        env.pop("VERL_FSDP_NO_SHARD", None)
    print(
        f"[launch] fsdp_mode = {cfg.train.fsdp_mode}"
        f" | dist_backend = {cfg.train.dist_backend or 'verl default'}"
        f" | steering = {'ON' if cfg.steering.enabled else 'off'}"
    )
    if "swanlab" in cfg.train.loggers and not env.get("SWANLAB_API_KEY") and not env.get("SWANLAB_MODE"):
        print("[launch] SWANLAB_API_KEY not set — falling back to SWANLAB_MODE=offline")
        env["SWANLAB_MODE"] = "offline"

    cmd = build_command(cfg, run_dir) + list(passthrough)
    if passthrough:
        print(f"[launch] WARNING: manual verl overrides appended: {passthrough}")

    manifest = {
        "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "config_path": str(config_path),
        "config_overrides": list(args.overrides),
        # The file every process actually read, and a hash of the settings that
        # define what this run optimises (resume checks it, see above).
        "effective_config": str(effective_path),
        "objective_fingerprint": fingerprint,
        "config": cfg.raw,
        "overrides": list(passthrough),
        "cmd": cmd,
        "run_dir": str(run_dir),
        "agent_workers": cfg.train.agent_num_workers,
        "launch_id": env["TRACE_LAUNCH_ID"],
        "doc_source": cfg.steering.doc_source,
        "research_contract": (
            {
                "backend": cfg.research.backend,
                "tool_protocol": cfg.research.tool_protocol,
                # v4 自体研究员没有 external 角色面(researcher 就是被训练的
                # policy 本身)——强取 roles["researcher"] 会 KeyError 拦死启动。
                "model": (cfg.roles["researcher"].model
                          if "researcher" in cfg.roles else "<selfres:engine>"),
                "endpoint": (cfg.roles["researcher"].endpoint
                             if "researcher" in cfg.roles else ""),
                "n_exp": cfg.research.n_exp,
                "k_default": cfg.research.k_default,
                "k_max": cfg.research.k_max,
                "max_turns": cfg.research.max_turns,
                "session_timeout_s": cfg.research.session_timeout_s,
                "thinking": (cfg.roles["researcher"].extra_body
                             if "researcher" in cfg.roles else {}).get(
                    "chat_template_kwargs", {}
                ).get("enable_thinking"),
            }
            if cfg.steering.doc_source == "researcher" else None
        ),
        "verl_path": verl_path or "venv",
    }
    manifest_path = run_dir / f"launch_manifest_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    print(f"[launch] run_dir={run_dir}")
    print(f"[launch] manifest={manifest_path}")
    print("[launch] " + " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
    return subprocess.run(cmd, env=env).returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

Exact required option values from your instruction: {"color": "red", "fit type": "men", "size": "large"}.

Preserve these values verbatim, including codes, punctuation and dimensions. Unusual values are not typos. Retain every other feature and price constraint in the instruction.

WHEN a search bar is available, search for the product type and discriminating task words. Search text does not select product options. Never assume the first result matches.

WHEN results appear, inspect title and price, then open a plausible product using a target from the current clickables list. Do not click Buy Now on a results page.

WHEN on the product page, map each required option above to its exact current clickable and select each with a separate action. Do not combine labels or invent targets.

Track successfully selected values in your action history for the current product. Unchanged page text after a valid option click is not evidence that the selection failed. Do not repeat an already selected value; a different value in that category replaces it.

WHEN all required options have been selected and visible product features and price match, make the NEXT action click[buy now]. Do not keep inspecting, reselect options, or return to search after this completion condition.

WHEN a required option is absent or visible evidence conflicts, inspect another candidate. Reset your selection record when changing products; never drop a requirement to make a purchase.

Invalid actions occurred in exploration: copy a single target exactly from current clickables; if unavailable, reconsider the page before acting.

Exact required option values from your instruction: {}.

Preserve these values verbatim, including codes, punctuation and dimensions. Unusual values are not typos. Retain every other feature and price constraint in the instruction.

WHEN a search bar is available, search for the product type and discriminating task words. Search text does not select product options. Never assume the first result matches.

WHEN results appear, inspect title and price, then open a plausible product using a target from the current clickables list. Do not click Buy Now on a results page.

WHEN on the product page, map each required option above to its exact current clickable and select each with a separate action. Do not combine labels or invent targets.

Track successfully selected values in your action history for the current product. Unchanged page text after a valid option click is not evidence that the selection failed. Do not repeat an already selected value; a different value in that category replaces it.

WHEN all required options have been selected and visible product features and price match, make the NEXT action click[buy now]. Do not keep inspecting, reselect options, or return to search after this completion condition.

WHEN a required option is absent or visible evidence conflicts, inspect another candidate. Reset your selection record when changing products; never drop a requirement to make a purchase.

# Evidence and recovery

No checked search shortcut is supplied. Derive search terms from your instruction and inspect the resulting page.

No successful exploration supports a task-specific solution. The procedure above is a task-grounded checklist, not a claimed verified solution.

"""WebShop-only Skill compiler: public task values + mechanically checked evidence.

Free-form researcher prose remains in session.jsonl but is not executed as a
student instruction. This is a new guidance variant, not a reward change.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import re

VERSION = 'webshop_clean_skill_v2'

def instruction_from_brief(brief):
    m = re.search(r'\bInstruction:\s*(.*?)(?:\nBudget:|$)', brief, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError('Clean Skill requires the public WebShop instruction')
    return m.group(1).strip()

def exact_specs(instruction):
    """Parse every public option label, without a fixed category whitelist.

    The first option follows the final "with" before its colon; later options
    are comma-delimited label/value pairs. Preserve option values verbatim.
    """
    instruction = re.sub(r'^Instruction:\s*', '', instruction.strip(), flags=re.I)
    instruction = instruction.split('[SEP]', 1)[0].strip()
    first_colon = instruction.find(':')
    if first_colon < 0:
        return {}
    prefix = instruction[:first_colon]
    withs = list(re.finditer(r'\bwith\s+', prefix, re.I))
    start = withs[-1].end() if withs else 0
    body = instruction[start:]
    body = re.split(r'(?:,\s*)?\band\s+price\s+lower\s+than\b', body, maxsplit=1, flags=re.I)[0]
    label = r'[a-z][a-z0-9 _()/\-]{0,59}'
    marks = list(re.finditer(r'(?:^|,\s*(?:and\s+)?)(' + label + r')\s*:\s*', body, re.I))
    if not marks or marks[0].start() != 0:
        raise ValueError('Unrecognized public option syntax; refuse ambiguous Skill')
    specs = {}
    for i, m in enumerate(marks):
        key = m.group(1).strip().lower()
        value = body[m.end():marks[i+1].start() if i+1<len(marks) else len(body)].strip()
        if not value or key in specs:
            raise ValueError('Empty or duplicate public option')
        # Attribute labels must never be swallowed by the preceding value.
        if re.search(r',\s*and\s+[^,:]+:', value, re.I):
            raise ValueError('Unparsed option boundary; refuse merged specification')
        specs[key] = value
    return specs

def safe_search_query(query, instruction):
    # Only task words and generic connectors can enter a reusable query. Do not
    # disclose a product ASIN/brand discovered privately during exploration.
    words = lambda s: set(re.findall(r'[\w]+',s.lower()))
    if not query or len(query.split())>32 or '\n' in query:
        return False
    return words(query) <= (words(instruction) | {'the','a','an','for','with','under','less','than','and','women','woman','men','man'})

def compile_skill(brief, records=(), proposal='', origin='researcher_finalized'):
    instruction = instruction_from_brief(brief)
    specs = exact_specs(instruction)
    records = list(records)
    query = None
    successes = 0
    invalid = repeats = 0
    for rec in records:
        traj = rec.trajectory
        successes += int(bool(traj.won))
        seen = set()
        last_search = None
        for s in traj.steps:
            invalid += int(not s.valid)
            pair=(s.action_norm,s.observation)
            repeats += int(pair in seen)
            seen.add(pair)
            match = re.fullmatch(r'search\[(.*)\]',s.action_norm)
            if s.valid and s.acted and match:
                last_search = match.group(1)
        if traj.won and last_search and safe_search_query(last_search, instruction):
            query = query or last_search
    # A proposal contributes only a task-grounded candidate search, never prose.
    # Success-derived queries take precedence; untested queries are labelled.
    query_status = 'Observed in a successful attempt; verify current results.' if query else ''
    if query is None:
        for candidate in re.findall(r'search\[([^\]\n]+)\]',proposal):
            if safe_search_query(candidate,instruction):
                query=candidate;query_status='Untested retrieval suggestion; verify current results.';break
    lines = [
        '# Task constraints and completion procedure',
        'Exact required option values from your instruction: '+json.dumps(specs,ensure_ascii=False)+'.',
        'Preserve these values verbatim, including codes, punctuation and dimensions. Unusual values are not typos. Retain every other feature and price constraint in the instruction.',
        'WHEN a search bar is available, search for the product type and discriminating task words. Search text does not select product options. Never assume the first result matches.',
        'WHEN results appear, inspect title and price, then open a plausible product using a target from the current clickables list. Do not click Buy Now on a results page.',
        'WHEN on the product page, map each required option above to its exact current clickable and select each with a separate action. Do not combine labels or invent targets.',
        'Track successfully selected values in your action history for the current product. Unchanged page text after a valid option click is not evidence that the selection failed. Do not repeat an already selected value; a different value in that category replaces it.',
        'WHEN all required options have been selected and visible product features and price match, make the NEXT action click[buy now]. Do not keep inspecting, reselect options, or return to search after this completion condition.',
        'WHEN a required option is absent or visible evidence conflicts, inspect another candidate. Reset your selection record when changing products; never drop a requirement to make a purchase.',
        '# Evidence and recovery',
    ]
    if query:
        lines.append('Candidate search query: '+json.dumps(query,ensure_ascii=False)+'. '+query_status)
    else:
        lines.append('No checked search shortcut is supplied. Derive search terms from your instruction and inspect the resulting page.')
    if invalid:
        lines.append('Invalid actions occurred in exploration: copy a single target exactly from current clickables; if unavailable, reconsider the page before acting.')
    if repeats:
        lines.append('Repeated action/observation pairs occurred in exploration: use your action history to choose the next unmet requirement instead of repeating an unchanged action.')
    if not successes:
        lines.append('No successful exploration supports a task-specific solution. The procedure above is a task-grounded checklist, not a claimed verified solution.')
    doc='\n\n'.join(lines)
    if len(doc.split())>500:
        raise ValueError('Compiled Skill exceeds 500-word contract; do not truncate exact values')
    return doc, {'version':VERSION,'origin':origin,'required_options':specs,
                 'source':'public_task_and_mechanical_episode_evidence','successes':successes,
                 'invalid_actions':invalid,'repeated_pairs':repeats,'candidate_query':query,
                 'free_form_prose_forwarded':False,'words':len(doc.split())}

def finalize_clean(router, proposal='', assessment='', origin='researcher_finalized'):
    st=router.state
    if st.finalized:
        return 'Already finalized.'
    if not st.episodes:
        raise ValueError('No exploration lineage: refuse synthetic research success')
    doc, audit = compile_skill(router.adapter.task_brief(), st.episodes.values(), proposal, origin)
    st.doc=doc;st.finalized=True;st.no_finalize=False
    st.self_assessment=json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False)
    st.flags=['clean_skill_v2',origin]
    return 'Clean Skill accepted. Exact task specifications and completion checklist preserved; unsupported free-form advice was not forwarded.'
